## Where to read

| Goal | Design | Where to read | Prompt entries |
|---|---|---|---|
| Screen data before analysis | No grouping design | [psyteachr quant-fun ch.11 Screening data](https://psyteachr.github.io/quant-fun-v3/11-screening-data.html) · CC BY-SA 4.0 | `missing-data-triage` |
| Describe variables | Within-subjects | [psyteachr Data Skills ch.2 Stroop (dataset source)](https://psyteachr.github.io/data-skills-v3/stroop.html) · CC BY-SA 4.0 | `describe-code-crosscheck`, `describe-first-look` |
| Compare two groups or conditions | Between-subjects | [lsj-book ch.11 Comparing two means](https://davidfoxcroft.github.io/lsj-book/11-Comparing-two-means.html) · CC BY-SA 4.0<br>[psyteachr analysis ch.7 Independent-samples t-test (Shapiro-Wilk, Levene, Welch)](https://psyteachr.github.io/analysis-v4/07-independent.html) · CC BY 4.0 | `ttest-assumptions` |
| Compare two groups or conditions | Within-subjects | [psyteachr Data Skills ch.2 Stroop (dataset source)](https://psyteachr.github.io/data-skills-v3/stroop.html) · CC BY-SA 4.0<br>[lsj-book ch.11 Comparing two means](https://davidfoxcroft.github.io/lsj-book/11-Comparing-two-means.html) · CC BY-SA 4.0 | `long-to-wide-check`, `paired-vs-independent` |
| Compare three or more groups | Between-subjects | [lsj-book ch.13 Comparing several means: one-way ANOVA (includes post-hoc tests)](https://davidfoxcroft.github.io/lsj-book/13-Comparing-several-means-one-way-ANOVA.html) · CC BY-SA 4.0 | `three-group-comparison` |
| Compare three or more groups | Mixed (between and within) | [psyteachr quant-fun (wrangling / ANOVA)](https://psyteachr.github.io/quant-fun-v3/) · CC BY-SA 4.0<br>[psyteachr analysis ch.13 Factorial ANOVA (Zhang et al. 2014 time capsule)](https://psyteachr.github.io/analysis-v4/13-factorial-anova.html) · CC BY 4.0 | `mixed-anova-setup` |
| Relate two variables | No grouping design | [psyteachr Analysis ch.6 Chi-square test of association (Ballou et al. 2024 dataset source)](https://psyteachr.github.io/analysis-v4/06-chi-square-one-sample.html) · CC BY 4.0<br>[psyteachr Analysis ch.9 Correlation (dataset source)](https://psyteachr.github.io/analysis-v4/09-correlation.html) · CC BY 4.0 | `contingency-association`, `correlation-choice` |
| Predict an outcome | No grouping design | No chapter linked yet | `regression-code-check`, `regression-predictors` |
